description_sq:
Shitet, Vile 2 kateshe, Ali Demi, 400,000 Euro
Karakteristika te prones:
– Vile 2 kateshe
– Lagjia Ali Demi
– Rruga Pasho Hysa
– 2 kateshe
– e mobiluar
– Siperfaqja e truallit 500m2
–Siperfaqja e banimit 229m2
– Cmimi 400,000 Euro
Shitet Vile 2 kateshe e mobiluar totalisht, e cila ndodhet pranë Kompleksit Kontakt, Rruga Pasho Hysa, nje lagje e qete dhe e mbushur me gjelbërim, pemë dhe ajër të pastër, vetëm pak minuta larg Tiranës dhe akseve kryesore.
Vila ka siperfaqe banimi 230m² (kati i pare 110m², kati i dyte 120m²) dhe organizohet ne 4 dhoma gjumi, 2 sallone ndenje + kuzhine, 2 ballkone dhe 3 tualete.
Vila ka izolim termik dhe panel diellor.
Aktualisht eshte dhene me qira 1400 Euro/muaj me kontrate afatgjate. Ideale per investim.
Pervecse per banim, vila eshte e pershtatshme per zyra, hostel, AirBnB, klinike, kopesht, servis etj.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe eshte e rivleresuar.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, 2-story villa, Ali Demi, 400,000 Euro
description_en: For sale, 2-storey villa, Ali Demi, 400,000 Euro Property characteristics: - 2-storey villa - Ali Demi neighborhood - Pasho Hysa street - 2-storey - furnished - Plot area 500m2 - Living area 229m2 - Price 400,000 Euro Fully furnished 2-storey villa for sale, which it is located near Kontakt Complex, Pasho Hysa Street, a quiet neighborhood full of greenery, trees and fresh air, just a few minutes away from Tirana and the main roads. The villa has a living area of ​​230m² (first floor 110m², second floor 120m²) and is organized into 4 bedrooms, 2 living rooms + kitchen, 2 balconies and 3 bathrooms. The villa has thermal insulation and a solar panel. It is currently rented for 1400 Euro/month with long-term contracts. Ideal for investment. In addition to living, the villa is suitable for offices, hostels, AirBnB, clinics, kindergartens, service, etc. It has regular mortgage documentation and is re-evaluated. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
